def solve_problem():

    m = Model("Optimization_Problem")

    # 2. Variables
    vars = {}
    lin_expr = 0
    vars['Var_0'] = m.addVar(lb=0.0, ub=8.16, vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name='Var_0')
    lin_expr += 5.94 * vars['Var_0']
    vars['Var_1'] = m.addVar(lb=0.0, ub=17.71, vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name='Var_1')
    lin_expr += 2.19 * vars['Var_1']
    vars['Var_2'] = m.addVar(lb=0.0, ub=16.01, vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name='Var_2')
    lin_expr += 2.35 * vars['Var_2']
    vars['Var_3'] = m.addVar(lb=0.0, ub=7.34, vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name='Var_3')
    lin_expr += 4.52 * vars['Var_3']
    vars['Var_4'] = m.addVar(lb=0.0, ub=19.96, vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name='Var_4')
    lin_expr += 3.63 * vars['Var_4']
    vars['Var_5'] = m.addVar(lb=0.0, ub=14.28, vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name='Var_5')
    lin_expr += 2.94 * vars['Var_5']
    vars['Var_6'] = m.addVar(lb=0.0, ub=17.18, vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name='Var_6')
    lin_expr += 6.08 * vars['Var_6']

    m.setObjective(lin_expr, GRB.MINIMIZE)

    # 3. Constraints
    m.addConstr(3.54 * vars['Var_0'] + 3.16 * vars['Var_2'] + 2.68 * vars['Var_3'] + 3.5 * vars['Var_4'] + 0.79 * vars['Var_5'] + 3.9 * vars['Var_6'] >= 74.94, name='C0')
    m.addConstr(4.23 * vars['Var_0'] + 0.3 * vars['Var_1'] + 4.6 * vars['Var_2'] + 1.15 * vars['Var_3'] + 2.41 * vars['Var_4'] + 7.98 * vars['Var_5'] >= 64.88, name='C1')
    m.addConstr(7.54 * vars['Var_0'] + 4.87 * vars['Var_1'] + 5.13 * vars['Var_3'] + 8.01 * vars['Var_4'] + 4.44 * vars['Var_5'] + 8.2 * vars['Var_6'] >= 183.87, name='C2')
    m.addConstr(2.03 * vars['Var_1'] + 5.64 * vars['Var_3'] + 3.47 * vars['Var_4'] >= 56.66, name='C3')
    m.addConstr(9.37 * vars['Var_1'] + 1.6 * vars['Var_3'] + 2.36 * vars['Var_4'] + 8.38 * vars['Var_6'] >= 153.14, name='C4')
    m.addConstr(3.81 * vars['Var_1'] + 9.94 * vars['Var_3'] + 3.36 * vars['Var_4'] + 6.79 * vars['Var_5'] + 7.94 * vars['Var_6'] >= 195.34, name='C5')
    m.addConstr(2.11 * vars['Var_0'] + 9.67 * vars['Var_1'] + 2.33 * vars['Var_2'] + 4.66 * vars['Var_3'] + 6.65 * vars['Var_4'] + 6.17 * vars['Var_6'] >= 173.78, name='C6')

    # 4. Optimize
    m.optimize()
    return m
